subject: words
title: Tricky words 3
about: The 5 tricky words from CKLA Unit 3 (because, should, would, could, down) plus 5 short phrases that use them. From Unit 3 the class guesses the spelling first (shood) and then sees the real one.
tip: Ask him how he thinks should is spelled, then show the real word and find the odd part.
